facts.quote: As our business continues to grow and evolve, so will our Direct Trade model to continue our mission of making the most positive impact where we can.
We do this by honoring our Direct Trade relationships, paying quality premiums for our coffees, and creating multi-year commitments to our producers.
Additionally, the campaign encouraged visits to Stumptown cafes, showcasing their unique brand experience and deepening customer engagement.

parsed.subject: Building a Connection
parsed.body:
Hi Stumptown Coffee Roasters team,

We’ve been thinking about how to deepen the connection between your brand and our Instagram community. We envision a collaborative post designed to highlight the importance of your Direct Trade relationships. Imagine a visually compelling post that showcases the dedication you have to your producers, emphasizing the quality premiums and long-term commitments you’ve built. The post could subtly weave in a feeling of shared passion and appreciation for the craft of coffee making. It would be a chance to reinforce the value you place on these partnerships and foster a deeper appreciation for the unique experience Stumptown Coffee Roasters offers.

The BrandPilot team
